comment: Single source of truth for the clone family. Add a copy or rename one by editing ONLY this file and committing; the next scheduled (21st, Africa/Cairo) or manual run picks it up. 'letter' is the variant letter; app_name is the launcher label; package must be unique per clone and stay fixed FOREVER once a clone has been installed on a device (renaming a package = new app, old data orphaned).

upstream.note: SOLE APK source (Sherbo, topic 76, 2026-10-22): the release assets of track_repo. Upstream ships one universal, already-De-Vanced-patched APK per release (Pixel-feature spoof incl. unlimited storage, DCIM backup control, account-persistence fix); no stock mirrors, no local patch bundle. pinned_version: null = track the latest upstream release each monthly cycle; set a Photos version string (e.g. "7.92.0.977185651") to focus that exact version - Sherbo can change it here. Built clones must keep minSdk <= 31 (Android 12); verify fails loudly otherwise.
